notes: Build008: Card-only previews: hold a hand card and release to dismiss; field cards stay enlarged with a red X. Swipe directly over cards in the collection and deck builder. Smaller mobile controls leave more room for cards. Current HP is explicit and selected damaged Characters have a Main Heal button. Your Main effects are slow ordinary play; Opp Main/Any Main remain conditional reactive effects. The in-game rulebook records these clarifications. Offline AI, cached collections and secure updates remain available.
